neighbours.label: Instructional prose that directs the reader to construct something (a diagram, map, formula, circuit, program): the function words inside the instruction
fire: In this activity, sketch a flowchart that shows how the program handles each input.
Once the circuit is wired, build a second stage and compare the output voltages.
For homework, construct a bar graph of the data and label both axes.
Next, write a function that returns the sum of the array and test it with three lists.
Using the grid provided, draw a map of your neighbourhood and mark the fire station.
After reading the chapter, create a timeline of the main events on a strip of paper.
With the kit assembled, solder the resistor to the board and attach the sensor.
To finish, derive the equation for the line and plot it on the same axes.
quiet: In this version, the flowchart shows how the program handled each input last year.
Once the circuit was wired, the second stage produced a lower output voltage.
For context, the bar graph of the data was published with both axes labelled.
Last week, the function that returned the sum of the array failed on empty lists.
On the old grid, the map of the neighbourhood showed the fire station in the wrong place.
After the chapter, the timeline of the main events runs along a strip of paper.
With the kit assembled, the resistor sat on the board beside the sensor.
In the end, the equation for the line was plotted on the same axes.

predictions: Worksheet and maker instructions reach 0.25-0.65 on an article, comma or conjunction inside the instruction; descriptive or narrative sentences about the same artefacts stay under 0.16.
notes: Probe: 'Write the formula for the illustrated function using a vertical shift' 0.647 (peak ' a'), 'When you finish creating the map, complete this work reflection' 0.371 (peak ','), 'Draw and label a systems diagram' 0.317, 'We implemented the algorithm using a block-style language' 0.299, 'schematic and details for creating one channel relay module' 0.229, 'Talk to your child' 0.122 (sentence-initial trigger); narrative twins 0.009-0.152. Card: classroom worksheets, code-generation notes, Arduino write-ups.
